title: DAS CDP — Architecture Diagrams
summary: The DAS Customer Data Platform architecture in ten diagrams, from system context down to infrastructure. Each is available as PNG, PDF, and the live Lucid source.

diagrams.title: System Context
diagrams.desc: The platform in one frame: external dealer and vendor systems in, one governed consumer record out, served to every downstream product.

diagrams.title: Layered Architecture Overview
diagrams.desc: The platform's layers end to end: ingestion, identity resolution, storage, and the API and frontend that serve the record.

diagrams.title: Full Component Map
diagrams.desc: Every component and how they connect, across ingestion, resolution, storage, serving, and the cross-cutting concerns.

diagrams.title: Intake
diagrams.desc: The four ingestion channels (batch pull, bulk upload, webhook, event stream) feeding one raw-first, replayable pipeline.

diagrams.title: Identity Resolution
diagrams.desc: The resolution engine: deterministic waterfall, fuzzy scoring, and the human curation queue that produces the golden record.

diagrams.title: Data Model & Golden Record
diagrams.desc: The bitemporal golden record, the identity graph, and the Phase 1 schema behind them.

diagrams.title: Security, Tenancy & Privacy
diagrams.desc: Row-level tenant isolation, the PII vault and delete-the-row erasure, and the consent ledger.

diagrams.title: Target-State Data Flow
diagrams.desc: How data moves from original sources through resolution to the golden record and out to consumers.

diagrams.title: Reporting & Legacy Cutover
diagrams.desc: The Superset reporting layer and the retirement path for the legacy SSIS and Juicebox stack.

diagrams.title: Infrastructure & Deployment
diagrams.desc: The portable open-source core on Kubernetes, Azure-primary and AWS-portable.
